name: Poison Bloom
description: Injects a virulent venom into a target within %cast_range% tiles, immediately applying %initial_poison% stacks of poison. For %duration% turns the poison grows instead of fading, and each of this unit's attacks on the victim adds another %duration_increase%. When the bloom finally ends - whether the host dies or the venom simply runs its course - it bursts, poisoning every enemy within %infect_radius% tile. Cleansing the bloom early prevents the burst entirely.
